name: Hans Melchers
bio:
Executive Officer at Multiplan Empreendimentos S.A. · Hans Melchers, born on January 16, 1982, is a seasoned finance professional currently head of Multiplan's accounting, tax, planning, and investor relations departments. Bringing a robust background, he joined Multiplan in 2006 and played a significant role in the financial planning and investor relations departments, contributing to key milestones, including the company's IPO.
Prior to his role at Multiplan, Mr. Melchers gained diverse experience, including roles in equity research at UBS, credit analysis at Shell Marine, and project management at Accenture Consultoria. He holds a bachelor's degree in business administration from PUC-RJ, an MBA in Project Management from IAG Master (PUC-RJ), and another in International Management from Université Pierre Mendes France.
